prompt: Who was older, the guitar player for the Dugites from 1982-1983 or the lead singer of The Sports?
answer: Andrew Pendlebury was older. He played guitar with the Dugites in 1982–83, while Stephen Cummings was The Sports’ lead singer. Pendlebury was born around 1951–52, compared with Cummings, who was born in 1954.
